description: This file defines a Perl package for a ResultSet class related to email blacklist management within a database schema. It includes methods for adding emails to the blacklist and checking if an email is okay, along with some configuration for the blacklist data type and columns.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistEmail
classes.description: A ResultSet class for managing blacklisted emails in the database schema, extending the base ResultSet class and including specific components for blacklist handling.

methods.name: add_email
methods.description: Adds a literal email address to the blacklist.

methods.name: is_email_ok
methods.description: Checks if the provided email address is not blacklisted, referencing external blacklist validation logic.

methods.name: _blacklist_default_type
methods.description: Returns the default hashing type used for blacklist entries, 'sha256_b64'.

methods.name: _blacklist_type_column
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column storing the email type, 'email_type'.

methods.name: _blacklist_value_column
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column storing the email value, 'email_fc'.
